_README: STAGING FILE — NOT loaded by DAB (not in data-source-files). These entities are wired and ready but their stored procedures do not exist yet (see ../proposed-procs/). Activate per ../proposed-procs/README.md: after each SP is deployed, move the matching entity into the live config (global_entities -> dab-config.json 'entities'; region_local_entities -> each config/dab-config.<region>.json with a region-prefixed name), then run 'dab validate' and redeploy.

get_account.description: Get one customer account's identity, enabled products, currency and status by AccountUid. Enabled-product flags (1=yes): Product_SMS, Product_CA (Chat Apps), Product_VI (Video), Product_VO (Voice), Product_AT, Product_ALERT, Product_Verify, Product_SUBSCRIPTION. Decode: BillingMode PREPAID/POSTPAID/NOPAY; CustomerType (allowed I/L/R/E/W — I=Internal/test, R=Reseller, E=Enterprise, W=Wholesale; verify L); CustomerCategory ENTA/WHLA/WHLB/WHL1/WHL2/VIP; RegionId 0=SG,1=ID,2=UK,3=US. AccountCurrency is ISO 4217. Excludes billing tokens (Stripe/PayPal). Global config data (AppCatalog / AppDb).

list_low_balance_accounts.description: List accounts at or below a balance threshold, lowest first, for proactive top-up outreach. Threshold omitted => each account's own LowBalanceThreshold is used. Optionally filter by Currency (ISO 4217). Amounts are in each account's wallet Currency. Global config data (AppCatalog / AppDb).

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: Balance at/under which to include an account (decimal). Omit (null) to use each wallet's own LowBalanceThreshold.

parameters.name: Currency
parameters.description: Optional ISO 4217 currency filter (e.g. USD). Omit (null) for all currencies.

region_local_entities._note: Add to each config/dab-config.<region>.json with a region-prefixed entity name, e.g. id_get_sms_by_umid. This is the TRUE single-UMID lookup (only @Umid needed) that the BQ-backed id_search_sms cannot provide.

get_sms_by_umid.description: Fast single-message lookup by UMID alone from the live SMS log (region-local), PII masked by default. Unlike id_search_sms (the cloud data warehouse, account+timeframe-scoped), this needs only a UMID — UMID is the clustered PK on msg.MessageLog so it is a direct seek. Decode StatusId via the 10-level model (0=UNKNOWN..50=READ); SmsTypeId 0=MO,1=MT,2=RCS_MO,3=RCS_MT_TEXT,4=RCS_MT_MEDIA. Excludes commercial price/cost. Region-local (AppDb_Data).

parameters.name: MaskSensitiveData
parameters.description: Keep true to mask destination MSISDN and withhold message Body. Only false with explicit authorization.
